references.text: Israel camped in the valley opposite Beth-peor, the same place mentioned in connection with Moses' grave.
Refers to the place in the valley opposite Beth-peor, where Moses spoke to Israel and where he was later buried.
Beth-peor is linked to Baal-peor, where Israel sinned, and now it is the place where Moses was buried.
God tells Moses that he will die on Mount Nebo, near where he was buried in the land of Moab.
The archangel Michael contended with the devil over Moses' body, referring to the fact that no one knew his burial place.
Moses went up on Mount Nebo in the land of Moab, where he later died and was buried by the Lord.
